arxiv-1510-07536.title: Anatomy of a blazar in the (sub-)millimeter: ALMA Observations of PKS 0521-365
arxiv-1510-07536.creator: S. Leon, P. C. Cortes, M. Guerard, E. Villard, T. Hidayat, B. Ocaña Flaquer, B. Vila-Vilaro
arxiv-1510-07536.description: Abstract Aims. We aim at analyzing the (sub-)millimeter emission in a nearby blazar, PKS 0521-365 , to study the synchrotron and thermal emission in the different components detected at low frequency. Methods. We analyze the archive public data of the ALMA Cycle 0 where PKS 0521-365 is used as a calibrator.

arxiv-2203-15766.title: From asymptotic freedom to θ \theta vacua: Qubit embeddings of the O(3) nonlinear σ \sigma model Preprint: IQuS@UW-21-025, INT-PUB-22-012
arxiv-2203-15766.creator: Stephan Caspar, Hersh Singh
arxiv-2203-15766.description: Abstract Conventional lattice formulations of θ \theta vacua in the 1 + 1 1+1 -dimensional O ​ ( 3 ) \text{O}(3) nonlinear sigma model suffer from a sign problem. Here, we construct the first sign-problem-free regularization for arbitrary θ \theta .

arxiv-2209-13555.title: Escaping Saddle Points in Zeroth-order Optimization: The Power of Two-point Estimators
arxiv-2209-13555.creator: Zhaolin Ren, Yujie Tang, Na Li
arxiv-2209-13555.description: Abstract Two-point zeroth order methods are important in many applications of zeroth-order optimization, such as robotics, wind farms, power systems, online optimization, and adversarial robustness to black-box attacks in deep neural networks, where the problem may be high-dimensional and/or time-varying. Most problems in these applications are nonconvex and contain saddle points.

arxiv-2410-07604.title: Light burden of memory: Constraining primordial black holes with high-energy neutrinos
arxiv-2410-07604.creator: Marco Chianese, Andrea Boccia, Fabio Iocco, Gennaro Miele, Ninetta Saviano
arxiv-2410-07604.description: Abstract Recent studies point out that quantum effects, referred to as “memory burden”, may slow down the evaporation of black holes. As a result, a population of light primordial black holes could potentially survive to the present day, thus contributing to the energy density of dark matter.

arxiv-2504-17001.title: Turbulence-dominated CGM: the origin of UV absorbers with equivalent widths of ∼ 1 \sim 1 Å
arxiv-2504-17001.creator: ​ ​ Aharon Kakoly, Jonathan Stern, Claude-André Faucher-Giguère, Drummond B. Fielding, Roy Goldner, Guochao Sun, Cameron B. Hummels
arxiv-2504-17001.description: Abstract Theoretical arguments and observations suggest that in massive halos ( > 10 12 ​ M ⊙ >10^{12}\,{\rm M}_{\odot} ), the circumgalactic medium (CGM) is dominated by a ‘hot’ phase with gas temperature near the virial temperature ( T ≈ T vir T\approx T_{\rm vir} ) and a quasi-hydrostatic pressure profile.

arxiv-2507-10601.title: AGFS-Tractometry: A Novel Atlas-Guided Fine-Scale Tractometry Approach for Enhanced Along-Tract Group Statistical Comparison Using Diffusion MRI Tractography
arxiv-2507-10601.creator: Ruixi Zheng, Wei Zhang, Yijie Li, Xi Zhu, Zhou Lan, Jarrett Rushmore, Yogesh Rathi, Nikos Makris, Lauren J. O’Donnell, Fan Zhang
arxiv-2507-10601.description: Abstract Diffusion MRI (dMRI) tractography is currently the only method for in vivo mapping of the brain’s white matter (WM) connections. Tractometry is an advanced tractography analysis technique for along-tract profiling to investigate the morphology and microstructural properties along the fiber tracts. Tractometry has become an essential tool for studying local along-tract differences between different populations (e.g., health vs disease).

arxiv-2507-11109.title: Can SMEFT discover New Physics?
arxiv-2507-11109.creator: Martin Hirsch, Luca Mantani, Veronica Sanz
arxiv-2507-11109.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Martin Hirsch, Luca Mantani, Veronica Sanz. We present a novel strategy to uncover indirect signs of new physics in collider data using the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) framework, offering notably improved sensitivity compared to traditional global analyses. Our approach leverages genetic algorithms to efficiently navigate the high-dimensional space of operator subsets, identifying deformations that improve agreement with data without relying on prior UV assumptions. This enables the systematic detection of SMEFT scenarios that outperform the Standard Model in explaining observed deviations.

pmc-10681355.title: Artificial intelligence and clinical decision support: clinicians’ perspectives on trust, trustworthiness, and liability
pmc-10681355.creator: Caroline Jones, James Thornton, Jeremy C Wyatt
pmc-10681355.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) could revolutionise health care, potentially improving clinician decision making and patient safety, and reducing the impact of workforce shortages. However, policymakers and regulators have concerns over whether AI and clinical decision support systems (CDSSs) are trusted by stakeholders, and indeed whether they are worthy of trust.

pmc-10689953.title: Research progress on antisepsis effect of apigenin and its mechanism of action
pmc-10689953.creator: Lin Zhu, Hairong Zhang, Xiaoyu Zhang, Lei Xia, JiaJia Zhang
pmc-10689953.description: Sepsis is an abnormal immune response to infections and can trigger MODS. Despite the availability of advanced clinical techniques and monitoring methods, the mortality rate of the disease is still high, posing a heavy burden to patients and the whole society. Hence, the research on novel drugs and targets is particularly important.

pmc-10825030.title: Case Report: effect of lumasiran treatment in a late preterm baby with antenatal diagnosis of primary hyperoxaluria type 1
pmc-10825030.creator: Francesca Taroni, Alfredo Berrettini, Michele Gnech, Francesca Rella, Gian Antonio Manzoni, Giovanni Montini
pmc-10825030.description: BackgroundPrimary hyperoxaluria type 1 (PH1) is a rare disease with autosomal recessive transmission, characterized by increased urinary excretion of oxalate, resulting in chronic kidney disease secondary to recurrent urolithiasis, nephrocalcinosis, and accumulation of oxalate in various organs and tissues (systemic oxalosis). Since 2020, an innovative pharmacological approach, namely, lumasiran, has been added to the therapeutic armamentarium (dialysis and liver-kidney transplantation).

pmc-11401477.title: Epithelial organoid supports resident memory CD8 T cell differentiation
pmc-11401477.creator: Max R. Ulibarri, Ying Lin, Julian C. Ramprashad, Geongoo Han, Mohammad H. Hasan, Farha J. Mithila, Chaoyu Ma, Smita Gopinath, Nu Zhang, J. Justin Milner, Lalit K. Beura
pmc-11401477.description: SUMMARYResident memory T cells (TRMs) play a vital role in regional immune defense. Although laboratory rodents have been extensively used to study fundamental TRM biology, poor isolation efficiency and low cell survival rates have limited the implementation of TRM-focused high-throughput assays. Here, we engineer a murine vaginal epithelial organoid (VEO)-CD8 T cell co-culture system that supports CD8 TRM differentiation.

pmc-12467975.title: 17βH-Neriifolin Improves Cardiac Remodeling Through Modulation of Calcium Handling Proteins in the Heart Failure Rat Model
pmc-12467975.creator: Rajasegar Anamalley, Yusof Kamisah, Nurhanan Murni Yunos, Satirah Zainalabidin
pmc-12467975.description: Background: Cardiac glycosides such as digoxin have been commonly used for patients with heart failure; however, their toxicity remains a main concern. 17βH-neriifolin (SNA209), a cardiac glycoside compound, has been recently isolated from Ceberra odollum Gaertn and was shown to improve the heart’s pumping ability in failing hearts ex vivo.

pmc-12516086.title: Bridging Knowledge Systems and Perspectives to Inform Salmon Management and Research: A Kuskokwim River Case Study
pmc-12516086.creator: Janessa Esquible, Avery Hoffman, Destiny Ropati, Brooke Woods, Jessica Black, Rachel Donkersloot, Mike Williams, Wilson Justin, Justin Leon, Carrie Stevens, Craig Chythlook, Tazia Wagner, Courtney Carothers
pmc-12516086.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In this research, we bridge knowledge systems and perspectives from Indigenous and rural fishers alongside state and federal managers and biologists regarding the state of salmon management and research processes in the Kuskokwim Region of southwestern Alaska. The key objectives were to identify strategies to improve salmon management, document perspectives on Alaska Native inclusion in current management and research processes, and illustrate ways to develop more inclusive management processes and organizations.

pmc-12590156.creator: Jiahui Ma, Fenghua Ma, Tingting Chen, Xin Lu, Yan Du, Xiaoni Yue
pmc-12590156.description: BackgroundNon‐gestational choriocarcinoma (NGCC) is a rare type of malignant tumor. Primary lesions are typically detected in the ovary and rarely invade the corpus uteri and cervix. NGCC usually has a poor prognosis due to the difficulty in achieving early and accurate diagnoses because of its rarity.

pmc-13039173.creator: Anwen Ren, Nan Feng, Tinglin Yang, Zimei Tang, Huan Liu, Yi Li, Qingyi Hu, Zihan Xi, Jiaqing Zhu, Jun Zhou, Jie Ming, Nan Liu, Tao Huang, Ming Xu

However, its effect in thyroid cancer has not been clarified.

pmc-13053133.title: Accurate quantification of the bacterial inoculum and tissue load in a preclinical model of implant-related infection
pmc-13053133.creator: Qi Sun, Dzenita Muratovic, Paul H. Anderson, Rebecca Sawyer, Helen Tsangari, Lucian Bogdan Solomon, Gerald J. Atkins, Dongqing Yang
pmc-13053133.description: AimsOrthopaedic device-related infections are a major and growing clinical complication of joint arthroplasty surgery. pmc-13094327.title: Enhancing High‐Resolution Assessment in Pain Disorders: Development of an Adaptive Real‐Time Version of the Pain Catastrophizing Scale
pmc-13094327.creator: Maria Roth, Constantin Yves Plessen, Gregor Liegl, Felix Fischer, Lena‐Sophie Koeppen, Peter Vajkoczy, Fabian Prasser, Sandra Nolte, Matthias Rose, Alexander Obbarius
pmc-13094327.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPain Catastrophizing Scale (PCS) scores have consistently been associated with heightened pain perception and poorer treatment outcomes. However, the PCS is typically administered as a trait‐level measure and does not capture within‐day fluctuations in pain‐related cognitions. With increasing interest in real‐time monitoring through Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA), there is a need for reliable and efficient instruments suitable for repeated use without inducing response fatigue or bias.MethodsThe German version of the 13‐item PCS was adapted using minimal linguistic modifications for momentary assessment.

pmc-13503625.creator: Jing Chang, Hui‐Lin Zhang, Qi‐Meng Zhu, Si‐Wen Hui, Xin‐Rong Xu, Mahmood Brobbey Oppong, Yan‐Li Feng, Juan Zhang, Cheng‐Peng Sun, Feng Qiu

uslaw-usc-t15-s6151.title: 15 U.S.C. § 6151 — National Do-Not-Call Registry
uslaw-usc-t15-s6151.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s6151.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 87A (National Do-Not-Call Registry). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Authority The Federal Trade Commission is authorized under section 6102(a)(3)(A) of this title to implement and enforce a national do-not-call registry. (b) Ratification The do-not-call registry provision of the Telemarketing Sales Rule (16 C.F.R. 310.4(b)(1)(iii)), which was promulgated by the Federal Trade Commission.
